children: US residential property insurer's Q3 revenue grew 83% yr/yr
Adjusted EPS for Q3 beat analyst expectations
Net premiums earned nearly doubled from a year earlier
Company did not provide specific financial guidance for future quarters or the full year in its press release
VOLUNTARY NEW BUSINESS - Co said growth was driven by a 57% yr/yr increase in voluntary new business policies sold in Q3
VOLUNTARY MARKET WRITINGS - Gross premiums written rose 23% yr/yr, mainly due to growth in voluntary market writings
REINSURANCE ARRANGEMENT - Lower ceded premiums earned due to reduced non-catastrophe quota share reinsurance
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 5 "strong buy" or "buy", 1 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the property & casualty insurance peer group is "hold."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for American Integrity Insurance Group Inc is $28.00, about 0.9% above its November 9 closing price of $27.76
